papers.title: Influence of surgical approach on heterotopic ossification after total hip arthroplasty – is minimal invasive better? A case control study
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Heterotopic ossification (HO) is a well-known complication after total hip arthroplasty (THA). Recently, the trend is to operate THA minimally invasive being less traumatic than standard approaches and promising a faster return to activity. The purpose of the study was to investigate if minimal invasive surgery (MIS), leads also to less HO after THA. METHODS: This retrospective study included 134 consecutive patients undergoing THA. In 42 (31.3%) patients a standard modified anterolateral (STD-Watson-Jones), in 28 (20.9%) patients a standard transgluteal Bauer approach (STD-Bauer), in 39 (29.1%) a MIS direct anterior approach (AMIS) and in 25 (18.7%) patients a MIS anterolateral (MIS-AL) approach was used. Standard preoperative anterior-posterior and lateral radiographs were assessed for occurrence of HO. HO was classified according to Brooker. In addition, short- and long-term adverse events were noted. Data was statistically analyzed using Chi-square tests, analysis of variance, multivariate data analysis and Pearson's correlation (p < 0.05). RESULTS: Overall, HO was found in 38 caucasian patients (28.4%) after THA. The STD-Watson-Jones group showed the highest HO rate (45.2% n = 19) with a significant difference to the AMIS (23.1% n = 9) and STD-Bauer approach (14.3% n = 4). No statistical difference was found to the MIS-AL approach (24.0% n = 6). Postoperative complications did not differ significantly except for a higher incidence of Trendelenburg`s sign in STD-Bauer. CONCLUSIONS: The rate and degree of HO after THA were significantly different with regards to the surgical approach. The standard modified anterolateral approach resulted in the highest HO rate, however, MIS approaches showed higher HO rates than the STD-Bauer.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究手术入路对异位骨化的影响，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡、微动或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical retrospective study on heterotopic ossification rates after THA with different surgical approaches; it does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or any biomechanical modeling of the femoral stem.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究微创手术是否减少全髋置换后异位骨化。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析134例患者四种手术入路的异位骨化率。
summary_zh.result: 标准前外侧入路异位骨化率最高，微创入路未显著降低。

summary_en.motivation: To determine whether minimally invasive surgical approaches reduce heterotopic ossification after total hip arthroplasty compared to standard approaches.
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis of 134 patients undergoing THA via four different surgical approaches, with HO classified by Brooker grade and statistical comparisons.
summary_en.result: The standard modified anterolateral approach had the highest HO rate (45.2%), while the standard transgluteal Bauer approach had the lowest (14.3%); MIS approaches did not consistently reduce HO.
summary_en.validation: Clinical radiographic assessment and statistical analysis of postoperative complications.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了预防性环扎钢丝对全髋关节置换术后股骨生物力学的影响，但未涉及应力遮挡或微动分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding in Gruen zones, does not report micromotion values, and does not compare intact vs implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估预防性环扎钢丝对全髋关节置换术后股骨生物力学的影响。
summary_zh.method: 在尸体股骨上植入髋关节假体，施加轴向载荷测量不同区域的应变。
summary_zh.result: 环扎钢丝改变了股骨近端应变分布，但未显著影响整体稳定性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过尸体股骨力学测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the biomechanical effect of prophylactic cerclage wires on femoral strain distribution after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Cadaveric femurs were implanted with hip prostheses and subjected to axial loading while measuring strains in multiple regions.
summary_en.result: Cerclage wires altered proximal femoral strain patterns but did not significantly compromise overall stability.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through mechanical testing on cadaveric femurs.

papers.title: PEG‐based organic–inorganic hybrid coatings prepared by the sol–gel dip‐coating process for biomedical applications
papers.abstract: In the present work, the application of functional coatings on metallic implants was proposed to delay implant failure by improving tissue tolerance and implant osseointegration. Three bioactive and biocompatible organic–inorganic hybrid nanocomposites, consisting of polyethylene glycol (PEG) embedded in a SiO 2 , ZrO 2 , and TiO 2 matrix, respectively, were synthesized via the sol–gel method. Materials in the sol phase were used to dip‐coat titanium grade 4 substrates for use as dental and orthopedic implant models. To investigate the influence of the glass matrix and the polymer amount on the coating structure, and thus on their biological properties, several hybrids were obtained by adding different weight percentages of PEG to each glass matrix. Attenuated total reflectance Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy confirmed the presence of the polymer in the nanocomposites and scanning electron microscopy showed that an increase in the PEG content allows crack‐free coatings to be obtained. Moreover, the bioactivity and biocompatibility of both the uncoated and coated titanium implants were investigated and compared by an in vitro test. The results revealed that coated substrates have more enhanced biological performance than the uncoated ones. The bioactivity is not significantly affected by either the inorganic matrix or the PEG amount, whereas the presence of polymer makes the films more biocompatible. POLYM. ENG. SCI., 57:478–484, 2017. © 2017 Society of Plastics Engineers

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究溶胶-凝胶法制备PEG杂化涂层以改善钛植入物的生物相容性，但未涉及AM、LPBF、多孔结构或力学性能。
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no porous structure, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过功能涂层改善金属植入物的组织耐受性和骨整合。
summary_zh.method: 溶胶-凝胶法制备PEG/SiO2、ZrO2、TiO2杂化涂层，浸涂钛基板。
summary_zh.result: PEG含量增加可获得无裂纹涂层，涂层提高生物活性和生物相容性。

summary_en.motivation: To delay implant failure by applying functional coatings that improve tissue tolerance and osseointegration on metallic implants.
summary_en.method: Organic-inorganic hybrid nanocomposites (PEG in SiO2, ZrO2, or TiO2 matrix) were synthesized via sol-gel and dip-coated on titanium grade 4 substrates.
summary_en.result: Increasing PEG content yielded crack-free coatings; coated substrates showed enhanced bioactivity and biocompatibility compared to uncoated ones.
summary_en.validation: In vitro biological tests and spectroscopic/microscopic characterization (ATR-FTIR, SEM).

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究全髋关节置换术后糖尿病、慢性肾病等合并症对预后的影响，未涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物力学分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical outcomes study with no biomechanical modeling, no FEA, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, and no implant design analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估合并症对全髋关节置换术后并发症和死亡率的影响
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析全国住院患者数据库，比较不同合并症组的结果
summary_zh.result: 糖尿病和慢性肾病增加术后并发症风险，但血液透析和肾移植患者风险最高
summary_zh.validation: 基于大型数据库的回顾性队列研究

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the impact of diabetes, chronic kidney disease, hemodialysis, and renal transplant on postoperative outcomes after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective analysis of a national inpatient database comparing complication rates and mortality among patient groups with different comorbidities.
summary_en.result: Diabetes and chronic kidney disease increase postoperative complication risk, with hemodialysis and renal transplant patients having the highest risk.
summary_en.validation: Large-scale retrospective cohort study using administrative data.
